text: Checked conditional component-law interface: an abstract post-bit projectedRound has the same full one-step State (n+1) value law as pinned Lean step when claims, coin, bit-invisible decision, and Vera check kernels equal the specified Lean component laws. The theorem assumes those equalities; it neither derives them from paper Figure 1 nor covers Bob policies that inspect the sampled bit, query-count laws, or resource bounds.
